verdicts.reason: A has a sensible banner structure: logo and big headline on the left, the ribbon in the centre, CTA on the right. Its flaws are a tiny product bottle crammed into the top-right corner against a background circle, fine print almost as large as the subcopy, and a right column that feels cramped next to the airy left. B stretches the ribbon into a huge diagonal bar across the whole canvas that runs into the bottle and nearly touches the headline. Its logo is tiny, the fine print is minuscule and wraps to an orphaned 'Co., 2026.', and the lower right is dead space.
